notes: Typed 2020 3-line form. Both schedules are ROTATED landscape sheets bound after the cover: p20 = FORM A (contributions), p21 = FORM B (expenditures), each with 24 printed data rows of which only row 2 is filled — row 1 on both sheets is an EMPTY printed row that the scan renders as a grey band (a shaded strip, not an entry), so the single entry indexes as row 2 on each sheet. The whole filing is one self-loan in and one filing-fee payment out, both dated 3/13/2020. Cover carries the filer label conflict already recorded in the stated-totals cache (the 'October 20 - Oct 27' box is ticked but it is signed December 10, 2020) and dashes, not zeros, on the Ending Balance line (kept BLANK per the zero-glyph ruling).
